title: The first higher direct image of $\mathbf G_m$ from the generic point of a smooth curve vanishes
statement:
Let $k$ be an algebraically closed field and let $C$ be a smooth connected curve over $k$ [def-sc-curves]. Then $C$ is irreducible; let $\eta\in C$ be its generic point [def-sc-generic-point], let $K=k(C)=\mathcal O_{C,\eta}$ be its function field [def-sc-function-field], and let $j:\operatorname{Spec}K\to C$ be the canonical morphism with image $\eta$. Let $\mathbf G_m$ be the etale sheaf $V\mapsto\Gamma(V,\mathcal O_V)^\times$ on the small etale site of $\operatorname{Spec}K$ [def-sc-gm-torsor]. Then the first higher direct image [def-weil-pbc-direct-image] vanishes:

$$
R^1j_*\mathbf G_m=0\qquad\text{in }\Ab(C_{\Et}).
$$
